biggest_catch: This is Chase's checking-account referral program ($50/referral, $500/year cap) — Chase's credit-card refer-a-friend amounts are account-specific and not fixed in public terms, so this is the only Chase referral route with concrete official per-referral terms.
catches: $50 per referral, maximum 10 referrals per calendar year ($500/year cap).
Only eligible Chase personal checking account holders (Total, Premier Plus, Sapphire, Private Client) about 30 days after account opening can be referrers; JPMC employees are excluded.
Friend must open a qualifying checking account through your personalized link — openings by any other route do not count.
Bonus is deposited into your primary checking account within 30 days, only if both accounts are open and not restricted at payout time.
Chase will not tell you which friends opened accounts (privacy).
Bonuses may be taxable; check with a tax advisor.

steps: About 30 days after opening your eligible Chase checking account, click 'Copy link' to get your personalized referral URL.
Share the link with friends (they must apply through your exact link).
Each friend who opens a qualifying Chase checking account via your link triggers a $50 bonus.
Chase deposits the $50 into your primary checking account within 30 days (up to 10 referrals = $500 per calendar year).
timing: $50 deposited into the referrer's primary checking account within 30 days after the friend opens the qualifying account.
